mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_deposit_history ( deposit_global_id, user_deposit_id, user_id, bank_name, product_name, account_number, join_date, maturity_date, applied_rate, base_rate, principal_amount, is_deleted, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, change_type, changed_at, changed_by ) SELECT d.global_id, d.user_deposit_id, d.user_id, d.bank_name, d.product_name, d.account_number, d.join_date, d.maturity_date, d.applied_rate, d.base_rate, d.principal_amount, d.is_deleted, d.created_at, d.created_by, d.updated_at, d.updated_by, #{changeType}, NOW(3), #{changedBy} FROM user_deposits d WHERE d.user_deposit_id = #{userDepositId}
